targetBase.interpretation: Immutable completed post-A2.8 snapshot before removing the production identity HTTP/SSE listener. The baseline remains historical evidence for the removed exposure, not an authorized runtime.

invariants.claim: The identity production binary serves only the existing tonic gRPC service and contains no second Axum or TCP listener.
The production binary neither defines, reads nor parses BIND_ADDR_SSE or a 50052 default.
POST /v1/emit is not mounted or referenced by the production binary code path.
GET /v1/stream/ranking-offsets is not mounted or referenced by the production binary code path.
The emit handler, event bus and SSE handler remain available only behind cfg(test) and are excluded from normal library and binary builds.
The identity proto, generated RPC shape and default gRPC port 50051 are unchanged from the target base.
The runtime still injects FreePlanRankingOffsetService and the service still returns RankingOffset::free_plan().
A2.9 removes an unsafe surface but adds no outbox, revision, cursor, replay, gap-repair or publisher mechanism.
The identity Cargo manifest, workspace lockfile and identity proto remain byte-identical to the target base.
A2.9 changes no database, generated schema, Diesel configuration or migration path.
A2.9 changes no Kubernetes or deployment file; checked-in 50052 and SSE configuration remains stale and explicitly blocked.
All evidence is local static inspection and exact offline compilation/tests and authorizes no network, listener, secret, deployment or production action.

residualStops.claim: Identity success still returns the Free Plan offset because the A2.7 resolver and A2.8 core adapter remain unwired.
The ranking snapshot SQL remains unexecuted against a certified adopted schema or populated data.
The LOWER(wallet_address) functional-index decision, row fan-out, query plan, latency and concurrency behavior remain unproved.
Identity gRPC still lacks workload identity, exact caller authorization, owner binding and TLS policy.
Removing the public emit hook does not create an authenticated authoritative publisher.
No transactional outbox, monotonic revision, durable cursor, replay, gap detection or repair mechanism exists.
No populated reconciliation proves plan assignments, ranking projection and market-consumer state agree.
Checked-in identity and analytics manifests still advertise port 50052 and IDENTITY_SSE_URL; A2.9 neither edits nor renders them.
No service is started and no image, gateway, Kubernetes, canary, rollback or deployment behavior is proven.
No shadow, parity, cutover or rollback procedure exists for the identity ranking projection.
Passing A2.9 integrity never authorizes a database, service, secret, network, deployment or production action.

E02 remove only the production 50052 parsing listener and route mounts

E06 certify adopted ranking schema index query plan and populated reconciliation separately
E07 wire authoritative paid ranking resolution behind authenticated workload identity and TLS
E08 publish only transactional versioned events with authenticated publisher cursor replay and repair
E09 reconcile projection and consumer state and test rollback before any cutover
